senses.gloss:
उप उप, ind. Under, on, near.
 I. adv. Near, further (ved.).
 II. prep. Near to (with the acc.), MBh. 1, 4099.
 III. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives (q. cf.).
 IV. Former part of comp. nouns and adv. implying Inferiority, Nearness, e. g. उप-वन (lit., an inferior, a small, forest), n. A grove.
 उप-कीचक, m. A partisan of the Kīcakas (a people).
 उप-ग्रह, m. A minor planet or any secondary heavenly body, as a comet, [] etc.
 उप-कन्या-पुर + म् adv. Near the gyneceum.
 --Cf. Goth. uf, e. g. in ufdaupjan (to submerge), ufsneithan (to cut up), and ufhaban (to lift); Lat. sub is compounded with स, corresponding to a Sskr. स-उप; likewise ὑπό.

उपरि उपरि, indecl. Over, above, on.

 2. On, with the gen., Yājñ. 2, 253 (adding to).
 3. Concerning, with the gen., Pañc. 94, 12; on account of, 214, 6.
 III. Former part of comp. nouns and former and latter part of comp. adv., e. g. उपरि-पुरुष, adj. Mounted by a man Daśak. in Chr. 188, 16.
 कर्परोपरि, i. e. कर्पर-, adv. Over earthen pots, Pañc. 218, 12.
 तरुवरोपरि, i. e. तरु-वर-, adv. On an excellent tree, Rām. 3, 35, 92.
 कथितवेलोपरि, i. e. कथित-वेला-, adv. After the appointed time, Lass. 44, 16.
 --Doubled उपर्युपरि, i. e. उपरि-उपरि.
 1. adv. Always higher, Hit. ii. d. 2 (those who look always above themselves, i. e. to their superiors); one above another, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 2.
 2. prep. Over, with acc., MBh. 1, 4648; with gen., Nal. 1, 2.
 --Cf. उप and ved. उपर, of which [] it is probably the loc. sing. slightly changed; Goth. ufar-; concerning Lat. super and Gr. ὑπέρ (properly ὑπερι in aeol. ὑπέρρ, ep. ὑπείρ.) cf. उप.

ऽउपाधिता -उपाधि + ता, f. in the comp. words उत्कृष्ट-, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 17; निकृष्ट-, 205, 3; अस्पष्ट-, 205, 5. The affix ता does not belong to उपाधि alone, but to its combination with the preceding part, e. g. उत्कृष्टोपाधि, etc., and these compounds are of the Bahuvrīhi class.
 उत्कृष्टोपाधि (vb. कृष् with the prep. उद्) as Bhvr. and adj. would denote ‘Having an excellent disguise;’ with the aff. ता, Condition of having an excellent disguise.
 नि˚ (vb. कृष् with the prep. नि), Condition of having, vile disguise; अस्पष्ट- (अ-स्प्˚), Condition of having an indistinct disguise.
